scripts.sugestie: wrangler d1 execute planer-sync --remote --command "SELECT id, datetime(created / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS kiedy, name AS kto, text AS sugestia, version AS wersja, screen AS ekran FROM suggestions ORDER BY id DESC"
